newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Coronation raises $50 mln for global growth.
newsitem.headline: Coronation raises $50 mln for global growth.

text.p: Coronation Holdings Ltd, the South African financial services group, said on Wednesday it had raised $50 million via an international equity placing and was expanding its international operations.

The company said it had placed 1.75 million ordinary shares and 1.2 million low-voting "N" shares with international institutions for cash. Proceeds of the issue will be used to strengthen the capital base of Coronation's international operations.

The group said its expansion of overseas operations would include investment management of international funds investing primarily in Southern Africa, management of international unit trusts and proprietary trading.
Coronation's international operations will be based in Dublin.
